title: Accounts Receivable and Billing Clerk
description:
An established and growing organisation based in Birmingham is seeking an organised and detail-oriented Accounts Receivable Clerk to join their fast-paced transactional finance team on an interim basis. This role is perfectly suited for a Sales Ledger professional who enjoys a high-volume environment and possesses a thorough approach to billing accuracy.

Working closely with the wider finance division, you will manage the end-to-end sales ledger process to ensure all weekly and monthly billing cycles are completed within strict deadlines. Your main focus will include generating and distributing high-volume sales invoices to corporate clients, reviewing daily cash allocations, and matching incoming BACS payments directly against client accounts. You will also take responsibility for managing complex statement reconciliations, investigating ledger discrepancies, and acting as the primary point of contact for external billing queries to ensure a swift and professional resolution.

Skills Required:
- A minimum of two years of solid experience operating within a dedicated Accounts Receivable or Billing function.
- Exceptional numerical accuracy with a sharp eye for identifying transactional errors.
- Comfortable navigating ERP accounting systems and managing spreadsheets using Microsoft Excel.
- A collaborative team player who can adapt quickly to new financial processes and fast-paced environments.

What You Will Receive:
- Convenient city centre office location with excellent access to local public transport links.
- A welcoming, collaborative team environment with a structured, thorough handover process.
- The opportunity to enhance your interim profile within a market-leading enterprise.
- Potential opportunities for contract extension or transition into permanent internal roles.

If you are an experienced and driven ledger professional looking for your next challenge within a dynamic and forward-thinking environment, we would love to hear from you. This is a fantastic opportunity to make an immediate impact within a supportive team that genuinely values individual contribution. To be considered for this immediate-start contract, please submit your up-to-date CV today to initiate a confidential discussion regarding your application.

title: Credit Control
description:
A successful and expanding organisation is looking to recruit an experienced and motivated Credit Controller to join its growing finance team. This is a varied and fast-paced role and excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys a diverse workload, building customer relationships and being part of a busy finance function. With continued growth and exciting future plans, the company offers a supportive and collaborative working environment where employees are encouraged to develop, take ownership and contribute to the success of the business.

Working as part of a friendly finance team, you will be responsible for managing the credit control process while supporting the wider sales ledger and billing functions. You will proactively chase outstanding payments, maintain customer accounts, allocate cash, reconcile ledgers and resolve customer account queries in a professional and timely manner. You will also prepare and issue invoices, investigate discrepancies, process account adjustments where required and work closely with colleagues across the business to ensure customer accounts remain accurate.

Ideally you will have:
- Previous experience in Credit Control, Sales Ledger, Accounts Receivable or a similar finance role.
- Experience managing customer accounts, chasing outstanding debt, raising invoices and allocating cash.
- Strong customer service and communication skills with the confidence to build relationships and resolve account queries professionally.
- Excellent organisational skills with the ability to prioritise a busy and varied workload.

In return, you will receive:
- The opportunity to join a well-established and growing business with exciting future plans.
- Flexible working hours and hybrid working to improve work-life balance.
- A friendly and supportive team environment where collaboration is encouraged.
- Ongoing training and development opportunities.

If you are an ambitious finance professional looking for a varied Credit Control role where you can utilise your experience while developing your sales ledger, billing and customer service skills, we'd love to hear from you. Apply now!

title: Credit Controller
company: Newstone Talent Solutions Ltd - Agency - Permanent
description:
Credit Controller

£30,000 to £36,000 Birmingham Hybrid working (2 days in the office, 3 from home)

An established professional services business is looking to appoint a Credit Controller to join its central Finance team.

This is an opportunity to take ownership of an allocated ledger, drive cash collection and support the business in maintaining strong cash flow, while building effective relationships with clients and internal stakeholders.

The Role

Reporting to the Credit Manager, you will be responsible for managing outstanding debt, resolving payment issues and ensuring customer accounts are maintained accurately and in line with agreed payment terms.

Key responsibilities include:
- Managing the end to end collection of outstanding debt across an allocated ledger, ensuring payments are received within agreed terms.
- Proactively monitoring aged debt, reducing overdue balances and escalating high risk accounts where appropriate.
- Building and maintaining strong relationships with clients and internal stakeholders to support timely payment and effective query resolution.
- Investigating and resolving invoice, purchase order and billing disputes to remove barriers to payment.
- Working with senior stakeholders to highlight collection issues, agree action plans and drive outstanding balances through to resolution.
- Providing regular updates on collection performance, aged debt and potential bad debt exposure.
- Supporting accurate account management, cash allocation, reporting and forecasting.
- Identifying opportunities to improve credit control processes and collection performance.

About You

You will have proven experience in credit control and debt collection, with a track record of managing outstanding debt and achieving cash collection targets.

You will also demonstrate:
- Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, with the ability to build productive relationships at all levels.
- Experience investigating and resolving invoice, PO and billing disputes.
- Excellent attention to detail and accuracy when reconciling accounts and maintaining customer records.
- Strong Excel skills, including VLOOKUP and PivotTables, to support debt analysis and reporting.
- A proactive and organised approach, with the confidence to manage competing priorities and take ownership of collection activity.

What's on Offer
- Salary of £30,000 to £36,000, depending on experience.
- Hybrid working, with 2 days in the office and 3 days working from home.
- The opportunity to join an established Finance team within a professional services environment.
- A varied role with ownership of a ledger and regular interaction with key stakeholders.

title: Finance Administrator
description:
About the Business

An exciting opportunity to join a well-established services business based in Marston Green as a Finance Administrator, paying £28,000 - £33,000 per annum. This is a genuinely rewarding role within an organisation whose work makes a real difference to people's lives, giving you ownership of the claims and payments activity behind a major funded programme. You'll lead a small, close-knit team and work closely with a supportive finance leadership team who are keen to help you develop.

Main Duties:

As a Finance Administrator, your main duties include:

Leading and developing a small claims and payments team, making sure everyone knows the standard expected on accuracy, output and deadlines

Planning and sharing out the team's workload so that every claim is processed correctly and on time

Keeping a close eye on capacity, quality and productivity, stepping in quickly to tackle backlogs, mistakes or staffing pressures

Coaching and supporting the team through regular feedback, handling performance fairly and building a culture of ownership and ongoing improvement

Making sure the team is properly trained, with clear procedures, guidance and points of escalation to rely on

Overseeing day-to-day claims and payment processing, reconciliations and the related finance admin, ensuring everything sits within the agreed remit

Making sure every team member follows the same checks, reviews and segregation of duties

Investigating significant queries, exceptions and anything out of the ordinary, resolving them or passing them up through the proper governance channels

Making sure all activity is backed by complete, accurate supporting evidence that is stored correctly

Overseeing the production of management information, financial reports and programme updates, making sure they go out on time

Keeping records accurate, current and audit-ready at all times, supporting both programme and financial assurance needs

Monitoring how well processes and controls are working, tracking exceptions and making sure corrective actions are followed through

Getting the team ready for audits, internal reviews and assurance visits from funding bodies

Working with colleagues to spot control gaps, repeat errors and new risks, agreeing sensible ways to deal with them

Handling financial, payroll and personal data securely and with complete confidentiality

Partnering with finance, compliance, operations, audit and shared services colleagues so the process runs smoothly from start to finish

Building strong relationships with funders, employers, partners and other external contacts through the agreed channels, ensuring queries are handled professionally and closed off promptly

Keeping senior colleagues informed on progress, team capacity, risks and exceptions, flagging any decisions needed in good time

Analysing trends and recurring problems to make claims and payment processing more accurate, efficient and consistent, and leading the rollout of agreed improvements to processes, systems and controls

Championing professionalism, a great level of service and real care over detail, while keeping your knowledge of procedures, controls and programme rules up to date

Location / Office / Culture

The role is based in Marston Green, within a friendly, collaborative finance function where the work you do genuinely matters. You'll be joining a values-driven organisation that cares about its people and the communities it serves, with a supportive manager who is keen to help you develop and genuine scope to make your mark.

What We Are Looking For

The ideal candidate will have:

Essential

Experience leading or supervising a team within finance, claims, payments or transactional processing

A track record of juggling workloads, deadlines and competing priorities while keeping quality high

The ability to motivate, coach and grow others while holding people to clear expectations

Experience in a busy, high-volume and well-controlled processing setting where getting things right and on time really counts

Strong numerical and analytical skills, with hands-on experience of payments, reconciliations or similar financial processes

Good Excel and finance systems skills, with confidence interpreting data and management information

Sound judgement and the confidence to challenge and escalate exceptions, risks and issues

The ability to turn contract or funding rules into practical day-to-day processes

Clear communication skills, both written and verbal, plus the discretion to handle confidential information

Desirable

Experience within a publicly funded, education or other regulated environment

Experience of grants, claims, payroll evidence or reimbursement schemes

Exposure to audit, assurance or compliance work

AAT/CIMA/ACCA or another relevant finance or management qualification

Why Join the business

A genuinely rewarding role where your work makes a real difference

Salary of £28,000 - £33,000

Lead and develop your own small team

Supportive, values-driven organisation that invests in its people

Broad role spanning claims, payments, controls and stakeholder management

About Us

We are a local accountancy recruitment specialist. We appreciate that roles are often online for a long period of time. If you want to check if this role is still live or just want more details before applying, call us directly.
